MemoryEvent.purpose: Raw normalized session signal before consolidation.
MemoryEvent.boundary: Raw event input only. Not canonical durable memory by itself.

MemoryAtom.boundary: Canonical durable unit used by retrieval and later consolidation.

MemoryEdge.purpose: Typed relationship between two canonical memory objects.
MemoryEdge.boundary: Directional graph relation that links source and target memory ids.

MemoryCapsule.purpose: Compressed scope-aware summary derived from canonical memory.
MemoryCapsule.boundary: Compression artifact for retrieval and packing; not a raw transcript blob.

ContextPack.purpose: Bounded explainable payload assembled for prompt injection.
ContextPack.boundary: Ephemeral output artifact for the current turn only.

shared_field_notes.scope: Scope identifier payload (for example global, repository, branch, or session scope).
shared_field_notes.provenance: Origin metadata describing producer, source context, and evidence refs.
shared_field_notes.confidence: Optional confidence score unless required by the object contract.
shared_field_notes.supersession: Supersession metadata is represented with supersedes/superseded_by when applicable.

invariants: Free-form transcript blobs are not canonical durable memory objects.
Objects stay valid when optional metadata is absent.
Identity, scope, and provenance are required on every canonical object.
